_comment: The exact PageController build this Runtime is qualified against, pinned by version and
by the digest of every file a deployment has to serve.
The Runtime (`web_runtime/assistant.js`) imports PageController from an absolute module URL the
application deployment supplies. Nothing in that URL says which build answered it, so
until this file existed the project's only statement about the version was prose -- and
that prose was wrong: THIRD_PARTY.md and the Runtime name both said 1.12.2 while every
Two digests rather than one because the module lazily imports its mask chunk; a
deployment that serves only the entry file has a Runtime that breaks the first time
that import resolves. The LICENSE is listed with them because serving the asset
redistributes it, and MIT requires the notice to travel with it.
Updating this is a deliberate act: change the version, record the new digests from the
npm tarball, and re-run the qualification that the old ones were qualified by.
